The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} equips the the {{Icon|hammer}} slot and is used when constructing [[blueprints]] and during several other select operations.  The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} can be found in the [[graveyard]] [[trunk]] at the start of the game or can be purchased from the [[Blacksmith]].  The hammer tool progression was bugged as Rusty hammers could only be crafted at the [[anvil II]] and [[iron hammer|iron hammers]] require steel and have the steel hammer sprite in-game. It can now be crafted at the [[Anvil]].

Efficiency represents how much progress toward an operation each swing of the Hammer provides. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} provides the base 70% efficiency. 

Energy usage represents how much energy each operation consumes. The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} requires {{Energy|-|1}} per swing.

Studying {{PAGENAME}} at the [[Study table]] will give you {{Techpoint|Red|10}}.
